author: haiku
label: seeded-01-01
changes: Added a 2-3 sentence summary of how the system works today and how the main flow goes.
Added a short terms section (secret store, version id, last good value, ready).
Gave every step the same four parts: what starts it, what it does, where its data lives, and what happens on failure.
Step 3: wrote out the brief's retry rule (3 tries, 2 s apart, then non-zero exit) and the refresh failure rule (keep last good value, warn). Previously just 'Retries on load'.
Step 4: stated that clients call get() on each use, so a refreshed key is actually seen. Previously it was implied only by 'switch to secrets.get()'.
Step 5: made readiness depend on all three keys being loaded, as the brief requires. Previously /healthz only added secret_versions.
Step 9: added the confirmation gate from the brief (every instance on the new version before revoking). The original step 9 just said 'rotate and revoke the old ones'.
Step 10 and the failure table: flagged that a pre-migration image cannot be rolled back to once old keys are revoked. The original notes did not say this.
Removed the standalone 'Don't log secret values' line. The rule now sits in the terms and in the loader step, where it applies.
Moved the rotation schedule into an Open questions section, with no cadence chosen, as the brief asks.
Kept the original step order and the step intent. Kept the file under about 1.5 times the original length; the required four-part layout made it slightly longer than that in places.
